operations.name: Sergey Turzhanskiy

expected.charges: Possession of an unregistered destructive device used against a Portland police car
expected.sentence: Thirty months imposed March 31, 2014. DOJ documents apprehension shortly after the November 5, 2012 incident, not continuous admission for the entire interval. BOP register 74816-065, Sergey Yefimovi Turzhanskiy, age 38, records noncustody as of June 6, 2016. Exact initial continuous admission remains unknown. The legacy 911-day sentence conversion is not documented actual custody and is cleared.

updates.plead: Guilty — possession of an unregistered destructive device

operations.source: https://www.justice.gov/usao-or/pr/portland-man-receives-30-month-federal-sentence-hurling-molotov-cocktail-portland-police — April 1, 2014 DOJ release explicitly identifies judge, prosecutor and guilty plea.
